# The Lantern Workshop

## Chapter 1: Observe

[p.1] A steady lantern makes every shadow easier to compare.

## Chapter 2: Test

[p.2] Change one shutter before measuring the next shadow.

## Chapter 3: Record

[p.3] Record the dimmest corner before ending the workshop.

[p.4] An unlit lantern can stand for a quiet promise. This is a viewpoint, not a procedure.
